// TEMPORARY diagnostics for the hosted runners (removed before the pull request merges). Prints
// facts only: times, counts, exit codes, drive letters and types, variable names.
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";

const out = (label: string, value: unknown) =>
  console.log(`[diag] ${label}: ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);
const ms = (t0: number) => Math.round(performance.now() - t0);

async function windowsChecks() {
  const { system32 } = await import("../../packages/service/src/hub/identity.ts");
  const ps = join(system32() ?? "C:\\Windows\\System32", "WindowsPowerShell", "v1.0", "powershell.exe");
  const base = ["-NoLogo", "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive"];
  const minimal: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(process.env)) {
    if (v !== undefined && /^(SYSTEMROOT|WINDIR|SYSTEMDRIVE|TEMP|TMP|USERPROFILE|USERNAME|PATH|PATHEXT|COMSPEC)$/i.test(k)) {
      minimal[k] = v;
    }
  }
  const pick = (name: string) =>
    Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(process.env).filter(([k]) => k.toUpperCase() === name.toUpperCase()));
  const run = (label: string, args: string[], env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv) => {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const r = spawnSync(ps, args, { env, encoding: "utf8", windowsHide: true, timeout: 120_000 });
    out(label, { ms: ms(t0), status: r.status, bytes: r.stdout.length });
  };
  out("names the full environment has and the minimal one lacks", Object.keys(process.env).filter((k) => !(k in minimal)).length);
  out("PSModulePath set in the full environment", process.env["PSModulePath"] !== undefined);
  for (const name of ["PSModulePath", "LOCALAPPDATA", "APPDATA", "ProgramFiles", "PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE"]) {
    run(`convertto-json minimal + ${name}`, [...base, "-Command", "ConvertTo-Json 1"], { ...minimal, ...pick(name) });
  }
  run("convertto-json minimal", [...base, "-Command", "ConvertTo-Json 1"], minimal);
  const { REGISTRY_SCRIPT, parseRegistryOutput } = await import("../../packages/launch/src/environment/layers.ts");
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const r = spawnSync(ps, [...base, "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-Command", REGISTRY_SCRIPT], { env: minimal, encoding: "ascii", windowsHide: true });
    out(`new registry script, minimal env ${i}`, { ms: ms(t0), status: r.status, parsed: parseRegistryOutput(r.stdout) !== undefined });
  }
  const { readWindowsFacts } = await import("../../packages/service/src/hub/sync-host.ts");
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const facts = await readWindowsFacts();
    out(`new sync facts ${i}`, { ms: ms(t0), ok: facts !== undefined, drives: facts?.drives.length });
  }
  const defender = spawnSync(ps, [...base, "-Command", "(Get-MpComputerStatus).RealTimeProtectionEnabled"], { encoding: "utf8", windowsHide: true });
  out("Defender real-time protection", defender.stdout.trim());
}

async function spaces(dir: string, label: string) {
  const { createFixtureSpace } = await import("../../packages/storage/test/space-helpers.ts");
  const d = mkdtempSync(join(dir, "diag-spaces-"));
  try {
    const t0 = performance.now();
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) await createFixtureSpace(d, `s${i}`);
    out(`${label}: 20 fixture spaces created, ms`, ms(t0));
  } finally {
    rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

out("platform", process.platform);
await spaces(tmpdir(), "os temp");
if (process.env["RUNNER_TEMP"] !== undefined) await spaces(process.env["RUNNER_TEMP"], "runner temp");
if (process.platform === "win32") await windowsChecks();
